spaces.delete.body.one: Its task is archived and its work tree removed. Branches and their PRs stay as they are. The space cannot be recovered. Projects are not deleted.
spaces.delete.body.other: Its {count} tasks are archived and their work trees removed. Branches and their PRs stay as they are. The space cannot be recovered. Projects are not deleted.

spaces.delete.body_empty: It has no tasks. It leaves the bar and cannot be recovered. Projects are not deleted.
spaces.delete.changed_body: What is marked appeared or changed while you were looking. Check it and confirm again.
spaces.delete.changed_title: There are new changes since you opened this
spaces.delete.failed_body: The space keeps them. Fix what each one says and delete again: it continues from here.
spaces.delete.title: Delete “{name}”
spaces.delete.uncommitted_why: They are discarded when you delete and can't be recovered. New untracked files too.
spaces.delete.unsaved_why: They stay in the task's copy.

spaces.error.busy: Another operation is changing this workspace's spaces. Try again in a moment.
spaces.error.child: A subtask goes with its main task. Move the main task and the family goes with it.
spaces.error.last: It's the workspace's only space and can't be deleted.
spaces.error.name_long: The space's name can't be longer than {max} characters.
spaces.error.none: This workspace has no readable space. Check the spaces folder before continuing.
spaces.error.outside: Ephemeral tasks don't belong to any space.
spaces.error.storage: The spaces couldn't be read or saved. Keep the files and try again.
